description: Returns full details of a workout from the team. Use when the user selects a workout or asks for details about a specific workout. Workout IDs come from list_team_workouts.

locale.description: Language for names and text, as a locale code, e.g. "en-US", "de-DE" or "de". Omit for the default language.

team_id.description: Team to act on. Omit to use the signed-in team.

name: get_team_workout
title: Get team workout
